answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when duplicate or fake activity is proven, and tie each identity to one scarce, hard-to-fake credential such as a verified device attestation. Like a single raven guarding a marble at a narrow inlet, the gate admits one agent per credential. An attacker creating thousands of fakes must buy a stake and an attestation for each one, so cost scales linearly with the attack, while an honest agent pays once and recovers the stake.
